title: Carve 0.2 paragraph interrupters
description: The five line kinds that end an open paragraph without a blank line. Every other line that is not blank is a lazy line of the paragraph.

name.description: The letter the block chapter gives the interrupter.

label.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

items.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

shapes.description: Names of rows in line-shapes.json. A line interrupts only when it has one of these shapes.

when.description: The line interrupts when it has one of the shapes and at least one of these conditions holds. `always`: the shape alone decides.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

carries_quote_marks.description: True when the line must carry the quote mark of every quote the list or the definition sits in (C2-B-020).

not_when.description: Cases the exceptions take out: the line is a lazy line.

lazy_shapes.description: The shapes of line-shapes.json that C2-B-024 names as lazy lines of an open paragraph. A bullet or an ordered marker is lazy only where no list is open.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
